result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: overlapping/garbled delivery info under Tokumaru Ramen Bar and inconsistent favorite-button background in Popular right now cards.

issues.description: Delivery metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is garbled/overlapping, appearing as '25-30rdelivery • Ramen' instead of readable time, fee and cuisine.
issues.suggestion: Fix text layout to prevent overlap so it reads clearly, e.g. '25-30 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' on a single line without colliding elements.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card lacks the dark circular background used on the pizza card below, showing as white outline directly on the image with lower contrast.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent favorite-button styling with translucent dark circular background to all large cards in 'Popular right now'.
